title: Change history entry
description: One shipped change, as `.ai/changes/CHG-NNN-<slug>.md` or as an inline entity block. AI.md section 6 records a shipped feature here because a change is the unit a reader asks about: not "what does RULES.md say" but "what changed when this landed".

feature.description: The capability that now exists, named the way a user would ask for it.

reason.description: Why it was needed. A change record with no reason cannot answer the question it exists to answer.

breaking.description: Whether this breaks an existing consumer. True is the answer that gets read; false must be deliberate.

migration.description: The steps a consumer must take. Required in practice whenever `breaking` is true.
